Question 12
?

Find the disjoint union of the sets A1={3,π,4} and A2={−1,4}.

a
{(3,−1),(π,−1)}
b
{(3,1),(π,1),(4,1),(−1,2),(4,2)}
c
{−1,3,π,4}
d
{(3,−1),(3,4),(π,−1),(π,4),(4,−1),(4,4)}

{−1,3,π}
